description: Global School Infrastructure Damage Dataset (1960–2024) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors BIKALPA GAUTAM, Rafael Ignacio Fernández (Singapore Institute of Manufacturing Technology). This dataset compiles structured information on school infrastructure damage resulting from natural hazards worldwide between 1960 and 2024. Data were extracted from 294 post-disaster reconnaissance reports published by major international organizations, including EERI, GEER, EEFIT, StEER, Build Change, and the World Bank GRADE program. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
